stem.text: In a chemical system the particles involved have a range of energies. This can be shown on a graph called the Boltzmann distribution.
Which statement correctly explains the effect of a catalyst on the particles in a chemical system?

A.text: A catalyst enables particles with a lower energy to collide successfully.

B.text: A catalyst increases the number of particles with higher energies.

C.text: A catalyst increases the number of particles with the most probable energy value.

D.text: A catalyst increases the value of the most probable particle energy.
